ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe (viewer's left) displays a dominant white contiguous region on its distal two-thirds, containing three primary dark circular blobs. The right lobe and central peduncle region are characterized by high-density black pigmentation, with a thin, irregular mottled white/grey band along the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharply defined vertex; approximate interior angle of 42 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge. The distal tips exhibit jagged, high-amplitude protrusions caused by dense barnacle colonization, particularly pronounced on the left tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following a parabolic arc from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel, diagonal, high-intensity white linear disruptions located on the black medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; two prominent linear rake marks on the left fluke lobe; organic debris or trailing skin fragments attached to the left tip barnacle cluster.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'pendant' like organic growth or seaweed entangled with the barnacle cluster on the far left fluke tip.
